name: hd_fs30_v2_pilotC
notes: PILOT C (docs/FS_PILOT.md): post-warmup mixing at v2-like settings without the v2 warmup. Pilots A (exact v2 recipe) and B (v2 + initial diagonal metric from hd_fs30) were both aborted under their pre-set rules: from warmup iteration ~8 on at least one of the 8 chains hits tree depth 10 (1023 steps, 164 s per 8-chain iteration) in nearly every iteration, projecting 3-4 h for 75-100 warmup iterations. Pilot C measures what v2 would see AFTER a long warmup: 8 vectorised chains started from 8 random draws of the M2 run hd_fs30, FIXED diagonal metric = diagonal of hd_fs30's pooled z-covariance (v2 adapts a diagonal metric), 30 step-size-only warmup iterations, 100 draws. Same model, likelihood (fast, exact), target_accept, tree depth. NOT independent of hd_fs30 (init and metric); its purpose is transition rates between the low-power and signal regions, ESS per gradient and IRN behaviour with 8 chains and a diagonal metric. Abort rule (fixed before launch): abort if the 30 warmup iterations take > 25 min; stop at the last 25-draw checkpoint ending before 12:53 UTC on 2026-10-08 (2.5 h of total pilot GPU time A + B + C).
